description: This is a Java source file for a Spring Boot REST controller named 'TutorialController' that manages CRUD operations for 'Tutorial' entities via HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: TutorialController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller handling CRUD endpoints for Tutorial entities.

methods.name: getAllTutorials
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all tutorials, optionally filtered by title.

methods.name: getTutorialById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific tutorial by its ID.

methods.name: createTutorial
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new tutorial.

methods.name: updateTutorial
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing tutorial by ID.

methods.name: deleteTutorial
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a tutorial by ID.

methods.name: deleteAllTutorials
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove all tutorials.

methods.name: findByPublished
